newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt offering public 20 pct of tv manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: Egypt offering public 20 pct of tv manufacturer.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Engineering Industries said on Friday it was offering a minimum 400,000 shares or 20 percent of subsidiary Telemisr/Arab Transistor Radio and Electronics Supplies.
Individual and institutional investors could buy at least 200,000 shares or 10 percent and the holding company said it would increase the stake on offer if demand warrants.
Telemisr's workers are allocated the remaining 10 percent.
Shares are priced at 30 pounds each and state-owned Banque Misr is handling the sale.
Individual investors can bid for a maximum of 50 shares while institutions have a 1,000 share limit. The offer will open on September 3 and ends a day later.
The firm said successful shareholders will receive a minimum 3.10 pound dividend for the 1995/96 financial year which ended on June 30, 1996.
Telemisr is the state's leading manufacturer of colour and black and white television sets. It produces sets under licence from Korean firm Goldstar and Japan's NEC Corp.

Its net after-tax profit for the 1995/96 financial year fell to 10.34 million pounds from 10.91 million pounds in the previous year but net sales were higher at 180.88 million from 170.04 million in 1994/95.
